allowed_extensions.title: Allowed file extensions
allowed_extensions.description: Comma-separated list of file extensions accepted by Media. Executable, server-side and active web content remains blocked by Media security policy even if added here.

max_upload_size.title: Maximum upload size (MB)
max_upload_size.description: Maximum size of one uploaded file in MB. PHP/web-server limits still apply. If upload_max_filesize, post_max_size or another server limit is lower, ask the server administrator to change it; Media does not use chunked or streaming uploads.

thumbnail_enabled.title: Generate thumbnail
thumbnail_enabled.description: Generate a thumbnail image variant when a supported image is uploaded.

thumbnail_width.title: Thumbnail maximum width
thumbnail_width.description: Maximum thumbnail width in pixels. Images keep their aspect ratio and are never enlarged.

thumbnail_height.title: Thumbnail maximum height
thumbnail_height.description: Maximum thumbnail height in pixels. Images keep their aspect ratio and are never enlarged.

midsize_enabled.title: Generate midsize
midsize_enabled.description: Generate a midsize image variant when a supported image is uploaded.

midsize_width.title: Midsize maximum width
midsize_width.description: Maximum midsize width in pixels. Images keep their aspect ratio and are never enlarged.

midsize_height.title: Midsize maximum height
midsize_height.description: Maximum midsize height in pixels. Images keep their aspect ratio and are never enlarged.
